text:
maya: Heads-up — wanting to pin new model `arsenal-3b:v1` to the catalog on Fri 2025-02-14 during the 16:00-17:00 PT quiet window. Who can own the pin + smoke and be on-call for rollback?

liam: I can do the pin + alias swap. Plan: canary first, then full pin. Need someone to own smoke scripts and quick QA.

sasha: I can run smoke tests. Suggest a short checklist: token sanity, sample prompt correctness, latency p50/p95, and a quick memory/oom sweep.

jen: QA signoff criteria: >=90% response completeness on our sample prompts, no embedding regressions flagged by similarity tests.

alvin: Ops — reserving slot now. Put owners and runbook here so infra knows it

ops-bot: Reserved slot 27 for team `eng-ml` on 2025-02-14 16:00-17:00 PT. Use `/reserve claim 27` to attach ownership.

liam: I'll do a canary at 16:10 PT -> 5% traffic for 10m. If health checks look good, promote to 100% at ~16:25 PT. Rollback plan in-thread.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: `arsenal-3b:v1` -> 5% at 2025-02-14T23:10:00Z (16:10 PT).

sasha: Smoke script (local):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/models/arsenal-3b:predict \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize the latest monthly revenue highlights"}'
```
I'll run this at ~16:12 PT and paste results.

maya: Ping on rollback command? Leave the one-liner here so the oncall can act fast.

liam: Rollback one-liner:
```
redwood catalog rollback --model=arsenal-3b --to=arsenal-3b:v0 --slot=27
```
(Also documented in the runbook: check canary pods -> drain new variant -> re-alias traffic)

jen: I'll watch the inference QA dashboards and the embedding similarity board — will ack or request rollback within the first 15m if anything looks off.

sasha: If I see any 5xx spike or tokenization drift >3%, I will call rollback immediately.

maya: I'll tag the channel at 15:45 PT as a final reminder and post a short checklist. Anyone need to reschedule?

alvin: Ops good for the window. :thumbsup:

liam: I'll post the PR link and final deployment ETA in this thread once I cut the canary job.

jen: Acked. Good luck everyone :rocket:
